---
title: "NFT vs COBYLA (new formulation, single-start SPIQ)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

QAOA runs with the NFT optimizer (Week112–116) and the COBYLA runs they restart from the same point (Week105–109).
Both use the new "qaoa" formulation, a single-start SPIQ starting point (the same JSON for both), reps 2, a budget of 1000
evaluations and trial 1. Only the optimizer differs. See `docs/RESULTS_INDEX.md`, "NFT instead of COBYLA".

**Optimal ratio** = the share of the 10240 samples that decode to the best plan (the same definition as `formulation.rmd`).
- **Raw:** the bitstring is decoded as it is. An invalid bitstring counts as a miss.
- **Fallback:** an invalid bitstring is repaired into a valid join order first.

**First iteration** = the readout at the first energy evaluation, which is the SPIQ starting point. **Final** = the readout at the optimizer's best angles.

```{r}
root <- normalizePath("..")
sub_dir <- "ExperimentalAnalysis/IBMQ/QPUPerformance/Results/CPU_Data/iterations_1000/reps_2"

runs <- tribble(
  ~problem, ~input_idx, ~cobyla_week, ~nft_week, ~ground_energy, ~target, ~qubits,
  "P1", 0, 105, 112, 1.1760913, 15,   3,
  "P2", 1, 106, 113, 3.6532125, 315,  8,
  "P3", 2, 107, 114, 2.3344538, 29,   8,   # best cost 29.4, stored as an integer
  "P4", 3, 108, 115, 4.9084850, 165,  15,
  "P5", 4, 109, 116, 8.3398488, 1605, 24
) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(cobyla_week, nft_week), names_to = "optimizer", values_to = "week") %>%
  mutate(optimizer = if_else(optimizer == "cobyla_week", "COBYLA", "NFT"),
         dir = if_else(optimizer == "COBYLA", "spiq", "nft"))

energy_csv <- function(r) glue("{root}/outputs/{r$dir}/energy/Week{r$week}/{sub_dir}/{r$optimizer}/input{r$input_idx}/trial1/energy_per_iteration_1000_{r$optimizer}_2_1.csv")
readout_csv <- function(r, stage) {
  if (stage == "final") glue("{root}/outputs/{r$dir}/Week{r$week}/{sub_dir}/{r$optimizer}/trial_1/readout_summary.csv")
  else glue("{root}/outputs/{r$dir}/Week{r$week}/{sub_dir}/{r$optimizer}/input{r$input_idx}/trial1/readout_summary_eval1.csv")
}

# The "# all_solutions" block of a readout: one row per sample and decoding (count/probability repeat the bitstring totals)
read_solutions <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  start <- grep("^#\\s*all_solutions\\s*$", lines)
  read_csv(I(paste(lines[(start + 1):length(lines)], collapse = "\n")), show_col_types = FALSE,
           col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
    select(cost, used_fallback) %>%
    mutate(cost = as.numeric(cost)) %>%
    mutate(used_fallback = as.logical(used_fallback))
}
```

```{r}
energies <- runs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(df = list(read.csv(energy_csv(pick(everything()))) %>% select(iteration, energy))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(df)

ratios <- runs %>%
  crossing(stage = c("first iteration", "final")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(sol = list(read_solutions(readout_csv(pick(everything()), stage)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(sol) %>%
  group_by(problem, optimizer, week, stage, used_fallback) %>%
  summarise(optimal_ratio = mean(cost == first(target)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(decoding = if_else(used_fallback, "fallback", "raw"),
         stage = factor(stage, c("first iteration", "final")))
```

# 1. Energy over iterations

Each plot shows one workload: NFT and COBYLA from the same SPIQ starting point. The dashed line is the exact ground-state energy.
The first evaluations differ slightly because the two optimizers take different first steps.

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
for (p in unique(runs$problem)) {
  d <- energies %>% filter(problem == p)
  g <- runs %>% filter(problem == p, optimizer == "COBYLA")
  print(
    ggplot(d, aes(iteration, energy, colour = optimizer)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = g$ground_energy, linetype = "dashed", colour = "green4") +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = g$ground_energy, label = "ground state", hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5,
               colour = "green4", size = 3) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(COBYLA = "grey40", NFT = "steelblue")) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "Energy evaluation", y = "Energy", colour = "Optimizer",
           title = glue("{p} ({g$qubits} qubits): NFT (Week{g$week + 7}) vs COBYLA (Week{g$week})"))
  )
}
```

## Best energy seen so far

NFT tries large angle changes while it fits each sine curve, so its raw curve jumps around. The running minimum shows the progress more clearly.
Both curves are normalized: 1 = starting energy, 0 = ground state. P1 and P3 start at the ground state, so they are left out.

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
energies %>%
  group_by(problem, optimizer) %>%
  mutate(best_so_far = cummin(energy),
         norm = (best_so_far - ground_energy) / (first(energy) - ground_energy)) %>%
  filter(first(energy) - ground_energy > 1e-9) %>%
  ggplot(aes(iteration, norm, colour = optimizer)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~problem) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(COBYLA = "grey40", NFT = "steelblue")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Energy evaluation", y = "Best energy so far (1 = start, 0 = ground)", colour = "Optimizer",
       title = "Progress toward the ground state")
```

```{r}
energies %>%
  group_by(problem, optimizer, week, ground_energy) %>%
  summarise(evaluations = n(), start_energy = first(energy), best_energy = min(energy),
            final_energy = last(energy), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(gap_to_ground = best_energy - ground_energy,
         share_to_ground = if_else(start_energy - ground_energy < 1e-9, NA_real_,
                                   (start_energy - best_energy) / (start_energy - ground_energy))) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Energies per run (share_to_ground: 0 = no progress, 1 = reached the ground state; NA = started there)")
```

# 2. Optimal ratio: first vs final iteration

```{r}
ratio_table <- function(dec) {
  ratios %>%
    filter(decoding == dec) %>%
    select(problem, optimizer, stage, optimal_ratio) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = optimal_ratio) %>%
    mutate(change = final - `first iteration`) %>%
    select(problem, optimizer, `first iteration`, final, change) %>%
    arrange(problem, optimizer) %>%
    knitr::kable(digits = 4, caption = glue("Optimal ratio, {dec} decoding: first vs final iteration"))
}
ratio_table("raw")
ratio_table("fallback")
```

Side by side, final iteration only:

```{r}
ratios %>%
  filter(stage == "final") %>%
  select(problem, decoding, optimizer, optimal_ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = optimizer, values_from = optimal_ratio) %>%
  arrange(decoding, problem) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4, caption = "Final optimal ratio: COBYLA vs NFT")
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot(ratios, aes(problem, optimal_ratio, fill = optimizer)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", optimal_ratio)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8) +
  facet_grid(stage ~ decoding) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(COBYLA = "grey55", NFT = "steelblue")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.08)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Workload", y = "Optimal ratio", fill = "Optimizer", title = "Optimal ratio: first vs final iteration, NFT vs COBYLA")
```
